newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices recover on festival buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices recover on festival buying.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Thursday recovered from recent losses on fresh consumer buying ahead of festivals as well as restricted arrivals, dealers said.
"Arrivals remained low from mills to the market as millers are witnessing higher outstation buying particularly from the Gujarat and Rajasthan region," one broker said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by eight rupees per 1,280/1,313 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved up by 5/15 rupees to 1,320/1,375 rupees per quintal.
Sugar mill delivery rose by five rupees at 1,220/1,230 rupees per quintal.
Bombay sugar markets are closed on Friday for a national religious holiday.
